title: CddsEndpoints
description: A list of CDDS service endpoints of the different CDDS services, derived from the CddsEndpoints message of cdds-configuration-endpoints.proto. The endpoints are grouped by service type in the following order: TC, TM, monitoring, control, TD. Several endpoints of the same service type are allowed within the per-service list.

tcEndpoints.description: The list of CDDS TC Service endpoints.

tmEndpoints.description: The list of CDDS TM Service endpoints.

monitoringEndpoints.description: The list of CDDS Monitoring Service endpoints.

controlEndpoints.description: The list of CDDS Control Service endpoints.

trackingEndpoints.description: The list of CDDS Tracking Data Service endpoints.
